body:
Dive into a world where magic, engineering, and automation come together!
This modpack combines the incredible machinery of Create, the programmable power of ComputerCraft, and the spell-crafting mastery of Ars Nouveau. Build complex factories, automate anything you can imagine, write Lua scripts to control your world, and harness customizable magic to explore, fight, and create in entirely new ways.
Perfect for players who love creativity, technical builds, and magical progression—all in one seamless experience.
